expectation: Membrane/dendritic network stain of follicular dendritic cells in the B-cell follicles of lymphoid aggregates, plus a dimmer ring on mature B cells. Rare: confined to a few round follicles; epithelium, muscle and stroma should be dark.
notes: CD21 lights the whole section alike: mucosa, epithelium and muscle layers. Blank areas show as saturated haze, and there are no follicle-shaped FDC networks anywhere. Its partner CD19 shows no cellular structure either, so row E cannot confirm anything.
observed: A: all tissue bright yellow, strongest in the muscularis, tracking tissue autofluorescence. B: saturated haze. C: gland epithelium lit. D: featureless saturation. E1: diffuse texture. E2: CD19 is unstructured haze, and the E3 green has no magenta partner.
why: The signal follows tissue and autofluorescence (muscle, epithelium, diffuse haze) instead of an FDC network or a B-cell follicle population.
